audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is credited to Karma at 7/10 and 2+ items to Dr. Mundo, while the page's own text calls 6 'a wash — neither of us kills the other' and the late game 'stays even'. diff is HARD but diffRating is 4/10 and both summary lines say 'Favoured matchup' at a 50% win rate.
audit.why: Neither champion can kill the other at 6 — Maximum Dosage is a heal with no lockdown, and Karma has no burst that beats regeneration.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and 2+ items both set to Skill at 5/10, per the mirror's atomic group; difficulty restated as even at 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is the generic 'no new ultimate at 6' template and gives Karma the row.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 so 6 is flat for Karma, and Maximum Dosage (120s) instantly heals a percent of missing health plus a long regeneration — a sustain reset, not a kill spike.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stated as a stalemate: he heals, he cannot catch you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his Q 'Infected Cleaver' (real name: Infected Bonesaw) in five places and repeatedly attributes healing to it — 'his Q heal', 'percent-HP cleaver heals', 'heals my single-Q chip back on every hit'. Riot's text for Infected Bonesaw has no healing at all: it deals current-health damage and slows. The healing is Heart Zapper (W) and Maximum Dosage (R). Nothing states that Goes Where He Pleases eats the first immobilizing effect.
audit.why: A player buying anti-heal to stop a Q that never healed, and spending Focused Resolve into a passive that deletes the first root, loses both the item slot and the lane's only lockdown.
audit.corrected: Healing attributed to Heart Zapper's stored damage and Maximum Dosage; Infected Bonesaw named with its 975 range and 4s cooldown; the passive stated as eating your first root, so bait it before Focused Resolve matters.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1 and heals off damage stored while it runs — poking into it feeds the heal.
audit.corrected: Poke after the Heart Zapper burst pops, never into the stored-damage window.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely mine — Mantra is up instantly, so I open with RQ Soulflare and drop the delayed zone on him as he steps up to last-hit, and his level-1 passive regen is far too small to erase that chunk. Stack a normal Inner Flame on top and he's pushed off CS with no heal to answer yet. But the moment Infected Cleaver and his passive are online, the trade math flips: he last-hits from cleaver range, heals my single-Q chip back on every hit, and there's nothing to all-in into — my W tether and thin frame can't burst a Mundo who just regens it. Don't waste mana trying to tax a target who out-sustains it.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely yours — Mantra is up instantly, so open with RQ Soulflare and drop the delayed zone on him as he steps up to last-hit, and his level-1 regen is far too small to erase that chunk. Stack a normal Inner Flame on top and he is pushed off CS with no heal to answer yet. But once Infected Bonesaw and Heart Zapper are online the trade math flips: he last-hits from 975 range, stores your chip in Heart Zapper and heals it back on the burst, and there is nothing to all-in into. Worse, Goes Where He Pleases eats your first root outright — bait it before Focused Resolve is the play.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 belong to him here, which is unusual for my poke pattern — Mundo's whole identity is soaking chip and giving it back through percent-HP cleaver heals and his passive, so the Q/RQ rotations that bully immobile melee just don't stick to a champion built to out-heal them. I keep poking to deny plate-CS pressure, but I respect that every cleaver he lands costs me more than my Q costs him. At 6 his Maximum Dosage is a heal, not a kill threat on me: it resets his HP but can't lock me down, and my range plus Inspire's speed keep me out of his cleaver line. That makes 6 a wash — neither of us kills the other, he just refuses to die.

notes: Biggest correction on this page: Infected Bonesaw does NOT heal. Riot's text gives it current-health damage and a slow only; the healing belongs to Heart Zapper (stored damage) and Maximum Dosage. The page said 'heals on every cleaver' in four places, under a fabricated name ('Infected Cleaver'). Second: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect, which eats Focused Resolve's root — absent from the page entirely, now in breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and early. suspectName 'Maximum Dosage's' is a FALSE POSITIVE (possessive form of his real R). tldr on Dr. Mundo's own page is reportedly truncated mid-sentence per the mirror notes — that is his file, not Karma's, but worth the champion-level check.
